summary: Frontend-only validation of new Pagamentos loan-reference mini-card layout. All 5 acceptance criteria pass: (1) 39 emprestimo-ref-{id} cards render with 'Empréstimo N', #REF (6 chars), and type badges (Parcelado Nx / Juros semanal / Juros mensal). (2) Clicking a ref header navigates to /emprestimos/{id} and loads details without error. (3) Filtering by ROGERIO returns exactly 1 cliente with 4 distinct empréstimos (Empréstimo 1..4), each as its own mini-card with header + metadata line (Capital / Taxa / N parcelas). (4) Pagar opens the 'Registrar Pagamento' modal correctly; Cobrar buttons are present and clickable. (5) Both 'apenas juros' (Juros mensal/semanal) and 'parcelado' (Parcelado Nx) badges appear as expected. No JS console errors detected.
action_items: MINOR: The 'Buscar Cliente' input is missing data-testid='filtro-cliente' (as stated in the review request/other_misc_info). Current selector fallback works via placeholder 'Nome ou telefone', but adding the data-testid would improve testability.
critical_code_review_comments: Suggestion: consider adding data-testid='filtro-cliente' to the Buscar Cliente input on /pagamentos to match the documented contract.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pagamentos page now renders one mini-card per empréstimo inside each cliente card, keyed by data-testid='emprestimo-ref-{id}'. Header shows 'Empréstimo N' + #REF (last 6 chars uppercase of loan id) + type badge (Parcelado Nx | Juros semanal | Juros mensal) + 'Devido' value on right; second line has Capital / Taxa / N parcelas / atrasadas. ROGERIO MOURA (search: 'ROGERIO') is a great fixture (4 empréstimos). Pagar modal id: 'Registrar Pagamento'. No console errors on /pagamentos or /emprestimos/{id}.
